item.title: Union soldier aged 16 to 19 found 162 years after Manassas; now set for Arlington burial
item.description: Archaeological findings at Manassas National Battlefield Park have led to the discovery of a young Union soldier's remains, believed to have been between 16 and 19 years old when he fought in 1862.
